method: privileged measured-state finite expert with online whole-body IK, footfall planning and bounded joint actuation
initial_state: fresh simulation, target at (2.30,0,0.09); no checkpoint or replay

high_level.goal: identify frozen target and delivery region; approach rear face without body collision
low_level: build collision-aware crouched whole-body IK reference
execute joint position reference under actuator caps

high_level.goal: move the ground-supported 5 kg target towards D without lifting
low_level: touch rear face with both hands
push 0.12 m at bounded per-hand force
high_level.entry: target upright and supported; robot stable; reachable rear contact
high_level.exit: target displaced, no hard violation; contacts permit withdrawal

high_level.goal: maintain reachable manipulation posture as target advances
low_level: raise pelvis and shift center of mass
high_level.exit: both feet supported, next hand contact reachable

high_level.goal: whole target in D, released and stable for at least 3 seconds; robot stable
low_level: lift and retract hands without collision
high_level.exit: measured target and robot terminal predicate, evaluated independently

trajectory_generation: approach_plan.npz is generated before physics; per-step IK and contact-QP references are generated from measured state while executing, recorded in command_trace.json; measured full qpos in joint_trace.npz; actual phase intervals in plan_mapping.json
success_policy: Final physical goal and public constraints only. Following this phase sequence is not a hidden benchmark requirement.
failure_policy: Preserve source, exception, video and all available traces. A failed expert does not certify task infeasibility.
